text: I am cheerful and completely happy with my annual performance appraisal.
I am crying in grief over the terrible loss of a trusted coworker.
I am enraged by the disrespectful treatment received from the client.
I am frightened that the company will shut down operations this quarter.
I was startled by the unexpected loud explosion in the industrial lab.
The filthy, roach-infested kitchen in the breakroom is utterly disgusting.
I am eager to lead the project but worried about failing our stakeholders.
I am furious and revolted by the corrupt cover-up by senior executives.
I was stunned and overjoyed to see my research paper accepted at top conference!
It makes me deeply sad and resentful that our loyalty was rewarded with job cuts.
The weekly sprint review meeting started at 11:00 AM as scheduled.
The engineering team closed four bug tickets and merged two pull requests.
I feel confident, proud, and ecstatic about our product release today!
The heavy feeling of despair and sorrow makes it hard to focus at work.
I am trembling with fear as the emergency alarm sounded through the building.
Finding out that the bonus was double what was promised was an incredible shock!
The foul smell emanating from the chemical leak was sickening and repulsive.
I am provoked and aggravated by the constant public humiliation from my manager.
